The solution is not a workaround. It’s base-layer [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-github-pages-free-digital-product-2|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]]. This post explains how to deploy a sovereign commerce stack that automates ebook delivery the moment a buyer pays in crypto. No platforms. No subscriptions. No KYC. You own the entire system after deployment. Built for creators who chose better architecture.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

This is a complete digital commerce infrastructure stack. It replaces platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy. It’s designed for creators who sell ebooks, courses, or templates but cannot use Stripe or PayPal. The stack consists of free and paid tools combined into a single system. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers your ebook file. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. The moment payment confirms, the system automatically emails the buyer a secure download link. You own every component. No platform can shut you down. No subscription fees. No transaction limits. This is infrastructure sovereignty — not renting, owning.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the technical flow: A buyer visits your storefront hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. They select your ebook and pay in crypto via NOWPayments. The payment is verified on-chain. A webhook triggers Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. The backend logic checks the payment status. If confirmed, it generates a unique, time-limited download link for your ebook stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The system emails this link to the buyer using Gmail or SendGrid. The entire process is automated. No manual intervention required. The architecture is modular. Swap components as needed. For example, replace Google Sheets with Supabase for more scalable order storage. Replace Gmail with SendGrid for higher email deliverability. The system is designed to adapt to your growth.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. Specifically: Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines, and similar markets. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, this stack gives you a fully operational online store. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent infrastructure. You own the code. You own the data. You own the deployment. No platform can dictate your terms. No subscription fees. No transaction limits. This is for creators who chose better architecture. Built in Zimbabwe. Pressure-tested against actual payment rejection, actual currency collapse, actual financial isolation.
Own your infrastructure. No platforms. No subscriptions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack combines seven core components: 1. **Hosting**: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (free). 2. **Backend Logic**: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script (free). 3. **Order Storage**: Supabase or Google Sheets (free). 4. **File Delivery**: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 (free). 5. **Payment Processing**: NOWPayments (0.5% fee). 6. **Email Delivery**: Gmail or SendGrid. 7. **Security**: HTTPS, time-limited links, and webhook validation. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, TRON (under $0.10 per transaction). The system is designed for minimal fees and maximum reliability. Every component is replaceable. Every deployment is sovereign.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all six blueprints, all seven templates, and instant download access. Deploy Stack 01 (GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments) in 48 hours. Load three products. Test end-to-end. Scale to Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase) as needed. The kit includes full source code, step-by-step guides, and a scaling playbook. No coding required for basic deployment. Advanced customization is optional. The system is designed for creators, not developers. Own your infrastructure. Deploy today. Sell globally. No platforms. No subscriptions. No KYC. Sovereign commerce — built for the people Stripe locked out.

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment works by integrating a storefront, payment processor, backend logic, and file delivery system. The buyer pays in crypto via NOWPayments. A webhook triggers Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. The system verifies payment, generates a secure download link, and emails it to the buyer. The entire process is automated and requires no manual intervention. You own the infrastructure. No platforms. No subscriptions. Sovereign commerce — built for creators who chose better architecture.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. 6. Set up email delivery: Gmail or SendGrid. 7. Test end-to-end: Simulate a purchase, verify payment, and confirm ebook delivery. 8. Deploy live. 9. Monitor transactions via Supabase or Google Sheets. 10. Scale to Stack 02 as needed. Own your infrastructure. Deploy today.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and templates. No coding required for basic deployment. Advanced customization is optional.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, TRON (under $0.10 per transaction).
Do I need to pay monthly fees for this system?
No. The system uses free tools (GitHub Pages, Google Sheets, etc.) and a one-time payment for the Complete Builder Kit. NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction.
Can I sell products other than ebooks?
Yes. The stack is designed for ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and other digital products.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
The system is modular. You can replace NOWPayments with another crypto processor. You own the code. You own the deployment. No platform lock-in.
